# New Zen Werkz Pte Ltd, car workshop in Singapore

> New Zen Werkz Pte Ltd is an independent car repair and servicing workshop at Blk 3 Kaki Bukit Road 1, #03-04 Eunos Technolink, Singapore 415935 (UEN 201900125K). It services and repairs continental cars such as Mercedes-Benz and Bentley as well as Japanese and American cars, including engine and automatic gearbox rebuilds, brakes, diagnostics and batteries. Tel 6742 8117, WhatsApp +65 8678 1878. Open Monday to Friday 9:30am-7pm, Saturday 9:30am-4pm, closed Sunday.
